review_scope: Technical comparison of 23 paired composed physical views for the waking Euplotes atlas restoration. The actual lunch birth and pose atlas parity have separate receipts.

images.observation: Case, pipe joints and gauge match the reference view, including shadow on the left fittings.
Bookcase stock, floor contact and doorway match, with the same dark upper shelves.
Tile joints and exposed cistern edge retain the prior tight framing.
Same close dark brick view; the mechanism remains obscured in this fixture.
Table, shelf, doors and main light pool match. Minor companion and reflection variation.
Lamp pool, curtain and glass boundary align. The seat retains its original crop.
Resident, clothing silhouette and room furnishings match. Companion face presentation and doorway brightness vary slightly.
Floor, chair and shelf silhouettes match beneath the same warm light.
Kitchen fixtures and wall light pool stay in place, with the steam and reflected light retained.
The open panel, hinges and conduit stay fixed. Their face lighting changes slightly between captures.
Cat cushion and under-counter supports remain in the same dim composition.
The cat and portrait retain their positions on the same dim shelf.
Canopy, brackets and framed pictures match; canopy still occupies most of the upper view.
Numbered brass mail bank, floor contrast and bench placement are consistent.
Heater profile, desk surfaces and slatted window register as before; foreground heater remains partly cropped.
Railing, leaf, steps and landing retain their shape and floor contact.
The tank, stairs and near parapet retain silhouettes. Clouds and lit windows vary slightly.
Terminal and wall board maintain placement; visible shadow gradients are consistent.
Tile and cistern shape match; the prior dark framing at the lower right is retained.
Colored floor residue remains legible and positioned within the lamp pool.
The installed form and floor contact remain in the lamp pool. The companion screen expression differs.
Kettle, toaster, counters and floor match; small transient flecks differ.
Wall-mounted station retains its face lighting and silhouette. The fixture remains dim.
